title: gogo config
description: Configuration of a gogo meta repository: .gogo, .gogo.yaml, .gogo.yml, their .gogo.local siblings and overlays merged with -f.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor support. Ignored by gogo.

projects.description: Child repositories: project path relative to the meta repository, mapped to its git URL.

ignore.description: Paths ignored when gogo walks the meta repository. Defaults to .git, node_modules, .vagrant and .vscode.

groups.description: Named sets of project paths, targetable with --group.

commands.description: Predefined commands for gogo run: a shell command, or an object with the command and its defaults.

cmd.description: Shell command run in every selected project.

description.description: Shown by gogo run without arguments.

parallel.description: Run in all projects at once instead of one after another.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of projects run at once when parallel.

groups.description: Only run in the projects of these groups.

includeOnly.description: Only run in these project paths.

includePattern.description: Only run in project paths matching this regular expression.

excludePattern.description: Skip project paths matching this regular expression.
